source.description: Planned six-panel handmade felt-tip-marker contact sheet.
source.notes: August 15 current Doodlea lesson; chosen for a distinct character silhouette and marker-color problem.

process_strategy: One upright penguin grows from two pale ovals and a centerline, then gets its black outer silhouette, white belly, one beak and two flippers, one wrapped scarf, face, thick outline, saturated marker fills, and final small accents without changing pose or countable features.

final_elements.name: construction guides
final_elements.description: Pale head and body ovals, centerline, belly, beak, flipper, scarf, and shadow routes.

final_elements.name: penguin silhouette, belly, and scarf route
final_elements.description: One upright black penguin silhouette with one white oval belly and one unfilled scarf band with a short hanging tail.

final_elements.name: beak and flippers
final_elements.description: One small orange beak and exactly two side flippers.

final_elements.name: wrapped scarf color
final_elements.description: One red scarf around the neck with one short hanging tail with exactly three pale stripe bands.

final_elements.name: face and marker color
final_elements.description: Exactly two oval eyes, two tiny cheek marks, black, white, orange, red, and pale blue marker fills plus one broken blue shadow.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: penguin silhouette, belly, and scarf route
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Belly and body texture stop under the scarf band and hanging tail routes.

frames.visible_job: Place a tall body oval, smaller head oval, centerline, belly oval, beak point, two flipper routes, scarf footprint, and broken shadow reserve in pale pencil.
Connect the guides into one upright penguin silhouette and one inner belly, then add the unfilled scarf band and hanging-tail route.
introduces: penguin silhouette, belly, and scarf route

frames.visible_job: Draw exactly two flippers and one small beak on their established routes.
requires_prior_elements: penguin silhouette, belly, and scarf route

frames.visible_job: Fill the established scarf red while keeping exactly three pale stripe bands on its hanging tail.
requires_prior_elements: penguin silhouette, belly, and scarf route

frames.visible_job: Add exactly two oval eyes and two cheek marks, then trace only established contours with thick imperfect black marker and fill existing body, beak, and shadow shapes.

must_persist: penguin silhouette, belly, and scarf route
new_occlusions: scarf band covers its reserved neck and belly route

final_step.visible_job: Only evens established marker fills, clarifies open-paper highlights, and strengthens existing contours.

rejection_checks: Reject a changed upright pose, flipper count, eye count, scarf route, stripe count, or beak shape.
Reject final-only face, scarf, color, highlight, or shadow additions.
Reject vector-clean icon art or glossy poster art; retain felt-tip texture and imperfect black outlines.
